title: Affine support radical criterion for a coherent map
statement: For a Noetherian commutative ring R, an ideal L, coherent modules A,D on Spec R and a morphism c : A.obj ⟶ D.obj invertible on the complement of V(L), the ideal L is contained in the radicals of the annihilators of the kernel and cokernel of the induced map on affine module sections.

source.place: Lemma 30.25.3 (088B), proof after reduction to an affine completed base

proof.text: Coherence implies quasi-coherence and finite affine section modules. For a in L, the basic open D(a) lies outside V(L), so the section map on D(a) is bijective. Localization gives elementwise a-power torsion for its global kernel and quotient by its range: injectivity treats the kernel, while surjectivity and clearing denominators treat the quotient. For each finite module, vanishing of its localization at a implies its support lies in V(a); support equals V of the annihilator, hence a is in the annihilator radical.

theorem coherentAffineMap_support_radical
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (L : Ideal R)
    (A D : CoherentModules (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))) (c : A.obj ⟶ D.obj)
    (hc : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
      (Scheme.Opens.ι (Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
        (L.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv.hom)).support.compl)).map c)) :
    L ≤ (Module.annihilator R
      (LinearMap.ker ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).map c).hom)).radical ∧
    L ≤ (Module.annihilator R
      (((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj D.obj) ⧸
        LinearMap.range ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).map c).hom)).radical
